description: A small red padlock and a red key are lying on the pink surface in front of you. The left hand reaches in toward the padlock, grasps and lifts it slightly, and the right hand comes in to steady it so the padlock becomes a two-hand object; the hands twist and adjust the shackle as if testing or unlocking/locking it, then the left hand sets the padlock back down while the key remains untouched nearby.
